ayahOccurrences.text: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ is in the derivative form: يَدْمَغُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/م/غ   d–m–gh brain, a concussion, to fracture a skull, to kill by a blow to the head; sunstroke; to vanquish, to destroy. Of this root, يَدْمَغُ yadmagh occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَدْمَغُ yadmagh [imperf. of v. دَمَغَ damagha, trans.] to break the head of, to cause great damage, to annihilate; to vanquish

(21:18) بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ no! We hurl the truth against falsehood, so it [the truth] crushes it [falsehood] [lit. smashed its [falsehood’s] head] and it [falsehood] becomes vanquished!
